info.title: sak api
info.description: The full api of the backend of sak: every route below /api/v1.

get.summary: The deployment that answers
get.description: The name, the dns mode (domain or subdomain), the user mode (multi with a mail server, single without) and the version of SAK of the deployment the backend belongs to. Needs no session.

200.description: The name, the dns mode, the user mode and the version of the deployment

post.summary: Request a login link
post.description: Sends a link with a login token, valid for 15 minutes, to the signin page of the apps if the address may sign in. An android app sends a nonce of 16 to 128 characters, the link signs in only with it. Answered the same way for every address.

202.description: The link is on its way if the address may sign in

400.description: No valid e-mail address or a malformed request

429.description: Too many login requests from this client

post.summary: Exchange a login token for a session token
post.description: Every login token can be exchanged once, a token of a link asked for with a nonce only with that nonce, one asked for without only without; the session token is valid for 30 days.

200.description: The session token and where the login started

401.description: The login token is invalid, expired or was already used

post.summary: Sign in as the admin with the admin password
post.description: The admin password is the password of the deployment. The session token is valid for 30 days. Only a few attempts an hour are answered.

200.description: The session token of the admin and where the login started

401.description: The password is not the admin password

429.description: Too many attempts from this client or altogether

post.summary: Exchange the token of a QR code for a session token
post.description: The token of the QR code a signed in user shows to connect an app (POST /api/v1/auth/connect), valid for 2 minutes and only once; the session token is valid for 30 days. Only a few attempts an hour are answered.

401.description: The token is invalid, expired or was already used, or the user may no longer sign in

429.description: Too many attempts from this client

get.summary: The signed in user

200.description: The address, its name if it has one, its roles and when the session expires

post.summary: A QR code that connects an app
post.description: The link the QR code shows: the SAK address with a token in its fragment, valid for 2 minutes and only once, that an app exchanges for a session of the signed in user (POST /api/v1/auth/login/connect). Whoever has the code signs in as the user until it expires. Only for a session, a few codes an hour.

200.description: The link of the QR code, its id and when it expires

403.description: A signed request of sakctl, which has no session to connect

429.description: Too many codes of this user

get.summary: Whether an app was connected with a QR code

404.description: The user has no such code, or it expired

post.summary: Create a bucket
post.description: Creates the bucket with a key pair that may access this bucket only, served at the domains in their order and at <name>.<root_domain>. The name can not be changed later.

400.description: No valid bucket name or one reserved for the controller's sites, a domain that is not valid or one the controller serves or redirects, or a malformed request

409.description: A bucket of the name exists, <name>.<root_domain> is already served, or another bucket is served at one of the domains

get.summary: The buckets with the number of their objects and their size
get.description: The numbers are counted in the background and kept, recounted after 5 minutes and after every write to a bucket; a bucket not counted yet is still computing, ask again.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

200.description: A page of the buckets with the domains they are served at and their statistics

400.description: An invalid page

delete.description: The bucket is no longer served and its key pair is refused. Its name stays taken and its objects stay in the storage until it is purged. A bucket that redirects lead to is not deleted.

404.description: Unknown bucket

409.description: Redirects lead to the bucket, named in the message

get.summary: A bucket with the number of its objects and its size

200.description: The bucket, the domains it is served at and its statistics

404.description: Unknown bucket

put.summary: Change the domains of a bucket
put.description: Serves the bucket at the domains in their order instead of its current ones, none for no domain.

200.description: The bucket with its new domains

400.description: A domain that is not valid or one the controller serves or redirects, or a malformed request

404.description: Unknown bucket

409.description: Another bucket is served at one of the domains

get.summary: The key pair of a bucket

200.description: The access key and the secret that may access the bucket

404.description: Unknown bucket

get.summary: The site of the access logs and the ranges of its metrics

200.description: The site with its domains, the ranges and the default range

404.description: No such site, or it is not served at a domain

get.summary: The request metrics of a site
get.description: Requests per status class and code, transferred bytes and user agent groups over a range.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: The range, one of the keys the access logs list, 24h by default

400.description: Unknown range

404.description: No such site, or it is not served at a domain

get.summary: Search the logs
get.description: The requests of the last 30d whose request line (method, host, path, status) or user agent contains the text, case-insensitively, newest first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text to search for, at most 200 characters

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

200.description: A page of the matching requests, newest first

400.description: No, too long or control characters in the search text, or an invalid page

404.description: No such site, or it is not served at a domain

post.summary: Redirect a domain
post.description: Redirects every request for the domain to an external domain, or to the first domain a bucket is served at. Caddy is configured right away.

400.description: No valid domain, the source is the target, a domain the controller or a bucket serves, or a malformed request

422.description: The bucket is unknown or not served at a domain

get.summary: The redirected domains

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

200.description: A page of the redirects, each with its target and the domain it leads to

400.description: An invalid page

put.summary: Change where a domain is redirected to
put.description: The redirected domain stays, its target is replaced. Caddy is configured right away.

400.description: No valid domain, the redirected domain itself, or a malformed request

404.description: The domain is not redirected

422.description: The bucket is unknown or not served at a domain

404.description: The domain is not redirected

get.summary: A redirected domain

200.description: The redirect with its target and the domain it leads to

404.description: The domain is not redirected

post.summary: Create a label
post.description: The name is stored in lower case with single spaces.

400.description: An invalid name or a malformed request

409.description: A label of the name exists

get.summary: The labels of the signed in user

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

200.description: A page of the labels, sorted by name

400.description: An invalid page

put.description: Every entity the label is attached to has it under the new name.

400.description: An invalid name or a malformed request

404.description: There is no such label

delete.description: The label is detached from every entity, its name can be used again.

404.description: There is no such label

get.summary: A label

404.description: There is no such label of the signed in user

get.summary: What the notes app may do
get.description: For every signed in user: whether the text of a photo or a recording can be discovered now (NOTES-5). The switches themselves are settings of the admins (GET /api/v1/settings/notes).

200.description: What the notes app may do

post.summary: Create a note
post.description: The note belongs to the signed in user. The labels are given by name, the ones that do not exist yet are created.

400.description: A too long text, an unknown color, an invalid label name, too many labels, too many photos, too many recordings or a malformed request, also with an unknown photo or recording

422.description: Only photos or recordings the user has not stored, or the user has no list of notes (they get one when they sign in)

get.summary: The notes of the signed in user

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Only the notes with the label of the name

200.description: A page of the notes, the newest first

400.description: An invalid page

get.summary: The labels of the notes
get.description: The labels a note of the signed in user has, by name: the ones the notes filter by. GET /api/v1/labels has every label.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

400.description: An invalid page

put.description: Replaces the text, the color, the labels, the photos and the recordings; the labels that do not exist yet are created.

400.description: A too long text, an unknown color, an invalid label name, too many labels, too many photos, too many recordings or a malformed request, also with an unknown photo or recording

422.description: Only photos or recordings the user has not stored

404.description: The signed in user has no such note
The signed in user has no such note

get.summary: A note

404.description: The signed in user has no such note

get.summary: What the grocery lists may do
get.description: For every signed in user: whether the items in a photo can be discovered now (GROCERY-16). The switches themselves are settings of the admins (GET /api/v1/settings/grocery).

200.description: What the grocery lists may do

post.summary: Discover the items in a photo
post.description: Reads the ingredients of a recipe or the items of a shopping list in a photo of the file storage with a vision model at OpenRouter; providers that collect the data are not asked. Nothing is added to a list: the items are added once the user confirmed them (POST /api/v1/grocery/items). Needs the AI features of the grocery lists turned on in the settings.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the photo in the file storage

200.description: The items in the photo, empty when it shows none

400.description: The file is no photo the user uploaded

404.description: The signed in user has no such file

409.description: The AI features of the grocery lists are turned off in the settings

429.description: The user had too many photos or texts read at OpenRouter lately

502.description: OpenRouter could not read the photo

503.description: No OpenRouter API key is set in the settings

post.summary: Create a grocery list
post.description: With the default categories, named in the language of the request (Accept-Language, GROCERY-13).

400.description: An invalid name or a malformed request

409.description: The user has a list of the name

get.summary: The grocery lists
get.description: The lists of the signed in user and the shared lists of the others, by name.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

400.description: An invalid page

put.summary: Rename or share a grocery list
put.description: Every user who sees a list changes its name and its icon, a shared list of another user too (LIST-2); only its owner shares or unshares it.

400.description: An invalid name or a malformed request

403.description: The user is not the owner and would rename, share or unshare the list

404.description: The user sees no such list

409.description: Another list of the owner has the name

delete.description: Its items go with it; only its owner deletes a list, their last one too.

404.description: The user has no such list

get.summary: The items to buy of a grocery list
get.description: By their category, the ones without one last; in a category the ones to buy in the order they were added, with checked=true the latest bought item of each name that is not to buy after them, the last bought first (GROCERY-14).

parameters.name: checked
parameters.description: true answers the latest bought item of each name too, each with its checkedAt

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

200.description: A page of the items to buy

400.description: An invalid page

404.description: The user sees no such list

get.summary: Suggestions for an item of a grocery list
get.description: The names of the items of the list that contain the text, one for each name with the values of its latest item, the names of the most items and the latest first, at most 10; the names to buy are left out. Only this list suggests them, every user who sees it sees them (GROCERY-11).

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: What the name contains, all when it is missing

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

400.description: An invalid page

404.description: The user sees no such list

delete.summary: Forget a suggestion of a grocery list
delete.description: For every user who sees the list: the checked items of its name go for good, an item to buy stays. Adding an item of the name brings it back (GROCERY-11).

parameters.name: suggestionId
parameters.description: The id of the suggestion (the latest item of its name), or of any live item of the list with the name

404.description: The user sees no such list, or it has no such suggestion

post.summary: Add a category to a grocery list
post.description: The last one; every user who sees the list (GROCERY-13), at most 30.

400.description: An invalid name or icon, too many categories, or a malformed request

409.description: The list has a category of the name

404.description: The user sees no such list

get.summary: The categories of a grocery list
get.description: In the order the list shows the groups of its items; every user who sees the list sees them (GROCERY-13).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

400.description: An invalid page

404.description: The user sees no such list

put.summary: Order the categories of a grocery list
put.description: The ids of all categories of the list, each once, in their new order; every user who sees the list (GROCERY-13).

200.description: A page of all categories in their new order

400.description: Ids that are not the categories of the list, each once, or a malformed request

404.description: The user sees no such list

put.summary: Change a category of a grocery list
put.description: Its name and its icon; every user who sees the list (GROCERY-13).

400.description: An invalid name or icon, or a malformed request

409.description: The list has another category of the name

404.description: The user sees no such list, or it has no such category

delete.summary: Delete a category of a grocery list
delete.description: Its items and the suggestions of the list lose it; every user who sees the list (GROCERY-13).

404.description: The user sees no such list, or it has no such category

post.summary: Add an item to a grocery list
post.description: An item names its list, one the user sees.

400.description: An invalid name, amount, unit or category, or a malformed request, e.g. without a list

422.description: The user sees no such list

400.description: An invalid name, amount, unit or category, or a malformed request

404.description: The user sees no such item

delete.description: An item, to buy or bought, goes for good, e.g. one added by mistake: no list shows it, no suggestion counts it.

404.description: The user sees no such item

put.summary: Set the category of an item
put.description: Of an item, to buy or bought: one of the categories of its list, or none; the next item of the name on the list takes it (GROCERY-13).

400.description: No category of the list, or a malformed request

404.description: The user sees no such item

put.summary: Attach a photo to an item
put.description: Of an item, to buy or bought: a file the user uploaded to the file storage (POST /files) that is an image. The next item of the name on the list takes it (GROCERY-12).

400.description: The file is no image the user uploaded, or a malformed request

404.description: The user sees no such item

delete.summary: Take the photo away from an item
delete.description: From an item, to buy or bought; the next item of the name on the list has none; the file stays in the file storage.

404.description: The user sees no such item

get.summary: The photo of an item
get.description: To every user who sees the list of the item. With size, the photo scaled to the smallest of 128, 256, 480, 1024 pixels on the longer side that is at least that large, a JPEG; larger, or without size, the photo itself. The apps ask for the size the photo shows at on the screen.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The file of the photo, photoId of the item

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The pixels the photo is to have at least on its longer side

400.description: No file id or no positive size

404.description: The user sees no such item, or the file is not its photo

post.summary: Check an item
post.description: The item is bought (GROCERY-3): the list no longer shows it, it stays as the history of the list, what its suggestions are made of (GROCERY-11).

404.description: The user sees no such item to buy

get.summary: The changes of the grocery lists
get.description: A stream of server-sent events (text/event-stream) that stays open: an event changed with the id of the list ({"listId": 2}) whenever a list the user sees, or its items, change, also when it is deleted, and when its owner unshares it, to every user who saw it until then. The event carries no data of the list, the client loads it again. A comment every 25 seconds keeps the connection open.

post.summary: Create a todo list

400.description: An invalid name or icon, or a malformed request

409.description: The user has a list of the name

get.summary: The todo lists
get.description: The lists of the signed in user and the shared lists of the others, by name.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

400.description: An invalid page

put.summary: Rename or share a todo list
put.description: Every user who sees a list changes its name and its icon, a shared list of another user too (LIST-2); only its owner shares or unshares it.

400.description: An invalid name or icon, or a malformed request

403.description: The user is not the owner and would rename, share or unshare the list

404.description: The user sees no such list

409.description: Another list of the owner has the name

delete.description: Its tasks go with it; only its owner deletes a list, their last one too.

404.description: The user has no such list

get.summary: The tasks of a todo list
get.description: Open and done alike, a done task keeps its place (TODO-3): by priority, the high ones first (TODO-5), then in the order they were added.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

400.description: An invalid page

404.description: The user sees no such list

post.summary: Purge the done tasks of a todo list
post.description: The done tasks of the list the request names, the ones the user saw done, are deleted; the open ones stay, and so does one done meanwhile (TODO-6). Every user who sees the list purges it (LIST-2).

400.description: A malformed request

404.description: The user sees no such list

post.summary: Add a task to a todo list
post.description: A task names its list, one the user sees, and may have a day it is to be done by (TODO-4) and a priority (TODO-5).

400.description: An invalid title, due date or priority, or a malformed request, e.g. without a list

422.description: The user sees no such list

put.summary: Change the priority of a task
put.description: High, normal or low (TODO-5), of an open or a done task; the list shows it in its new place. Every user who sees its list changes it (LIST-2).

400.description: An invalid priority, or a malformed request

404.description: The user sees no such task

put.summary: Set or remove the due date of a task
put.description: The day a task is to be done by, of an open or a done task; none takes it away (TODO-4). Every user who sees its list changes it (LIST-2).

400.description: An invalid due date, or a malformed request

404.description: The user sees no such task

put.summary: Mark a task done or open again
put.description: A done task stays on its list, struck through, until the list is purged (TODO-3, TODO-6). Every user who sees its list marks it, also one another user added (LIST-2).

400.description: A malformed request

404.description: The user sees no such task

get.summary: The changes of the todo lists
get.description: A stream of server-sent events (text/event-stream) that stays open: an event changed with the id of the list ({"listId": 2}) whenever a list the user sees, or its tasks, change, also when it is deleted, and when its owner unshares it, to every user who saw it until then. The event carries no data of the list, the client loads it again. A comment every 25 seconds keeps the connection open.

post.summary: Add a user
post.description: The user signs in with a link by e-mail and uses the notes, the grocery lists and the todo lists (the role user). No mail is sent.

400.description: An invalid address or name, or a malformed request

409.description: A user of the address exists, or it is an admin of the configuration

get.summary: The users
get.description: The admins of the configuration of the deployment first, then the users an admin added, by address.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

400.description: An invalid page

post.summary: Send the links of the Android apps
post.description: Sends a user or an admin of the deployment an e-mail with the links to the pages that download the Android apps: the grocery lists (/grocery/download/app), the notes (/notes/download/app) and the todo lists (/todo/download/app), in the language of the request.

404.description: The address is no user or admin of the deployment

409.description: The deployment has no mail server

502.description: The mail server did not take the e-mail

delete.description: The user can no longer sign in, their sessions end with their next request; their data stays.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the added user

404.description: No such added user; an admin of the configuration is not deleted here

get.summary: The scopes of settings
get.description: Every scope with its settings, their labels, types and defaults, what the settings page is built from. Admins only.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts in the whole list, 0 by default

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items the page has at most, 50 by default and 100 at most

400.description: An invalid page

put.summary: Change the settings of a scope
put.description: Sets the values of the settings named; the others keep their values. Every value is validated first, one that is not valid sets none. Admins only.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: The name of the scope, e.g. openrouter

200.description: Every setting of the scope with its value, after the change

400.description: An unknown setting, a value of the wrong type or not valid, or a malformed request

404.description: There is no such scope

get.summary: The settings of a scope
get.description: Every setting of the scope with its stored value, also while it is off; with effective=true as the apps use it, the default for a setting that is off. A masked value shows its first characters only. Admins only.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: The name of the scope, e.g. openrouter

parameters.name: effective
parameters.description: true for the values as the apps use them, false by default

200.description: The settings of the scope, by their names

404.description: There is no such scope

get.summary: The health of the backend
get.description: Runs every health check, e.g. whether the domains of the buckets and the redirects point to the server.

200.description: The status of every check, in a fixed order

post.summary: Store a file
post.description: The body is the content of the file. Every upload is a file of its own, served at /api/v1/files/{id}. The type is told by the content.

400.description: A type the storage does not take, content that is no such file, an image larger than 2048 pixels, or a recording longer than 5 minutes

413.description: A file larger than the storage takes

post.summary: Discover the text in an image or a recording
post.description: Reads the text in an image with a vision model, writes down a recording with a speech to text model, both at OpenRouter; providers that collect the data are not asked. The text is kept with the file, a file is only read once. Needs the AI features turned on in the settings.

200.description: The text in the image or the recording, empty when there is none

400.description: The file is neither an image nor a recording

404.description: The signed in user has no such file

409.description: The AI features are turned off in the settings

429.description: The user had too many texts discovered at OpenRouter lately; a known text does not count

502.description: OpenRouter could not read the file

503.description: No OpenRouter API key is set in the settings

get.summary: The content of a stored file

404.description: The signed in user has no such file

get.summary: The thumbnail of a stored image or recording
get.description: A JPEG of at most 480 pixels on the longer side, of a recording its waveform; made when it is first asked for.

404.description: The signed in user has no such file, or it is neither an image nor a recording that can be read

get.summary: The settings of the deployment
get.description: The name, the dns mode, the root domain, the user mode, the admin, the mail server with its password and the acme ca the deployment runs with, so sakctl can deploy it again with them. Only for a request signed by sakctl, no session.

session.description: The session token the apps get for a login link, see POST /api/v1/auth/login/exchange.

api-signature.description: A request sakctl signs with the ed25519 key it derives from the password of the deployment, see sakctl config show: the signature holds for the host, the method, the path, the time and a nonce of its own.
